en.hubeali:
From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Aziz Al Abidy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[29:49] But these are clear Verses in the chests of those who are granted Knowledge
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him from Muhammad ibn Ali from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd al-‘Aziz al-‘Abdi from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“In fact, the Quran consists of illustrious verses that exist in the hearts of those who have knowledge. . .” [29:49]
